mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.rate_year, r.grade_id, g.name AS grade_name, r.daily_amount, r.updated_by, u.name AS updated_by_name, r.updated_at FROM leave_allowance_rates r JOIN emp_grades g ON g.id = r.grade_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = r.updated_by WHERE r.rate_year = #{year} ORDER BY g.display_order, g.id
SELECT DISTINCT rate_year FROM leave_allowance_rates ORDER BY rate_year DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_allowance_rates(rate_year, grade_id, daily_amount, updated_by) VALUES(#{rateYear}, #{gradeId}, #{dailyAmount}, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE daily_amount = VALUES(daily_amount), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM leave_allowance_rates WHERE rate_year = #{year} AND grade_id = #{gradeId}
